messages:
alerts-bot: INCIDENT: reserved pool 'resv-eu-2' GPU utilization=100% · queue length=612 · autoscaler status=FAILED (reached max_replicas). Possible noisy neighbor. Impact: enterprise reserved tenants may see throttling/429s. Alerts: queue>500 for 5m.
arthur (oncall): ack. paging oncall. i'm connecting to pool manager and autoscaler now.
sahil: i'm up. pulling autoscaler logs and reservation metrics. tagging infra if quota issue.
diana: CS: OrchidBank reporting 429s since ~10:12 UTC, SLA risk. GreenfieldPay also seeing degraded throughput. i've informed cs-escalations.
arthur (oncall): past 30m we had a burst from a single tenant? sahil any signs of heavy single-tenant usage?
sahil: running tenant breakdown...
```
# tenant_gpu_use --start 2026-03-15T10:00Z --end 2026-03-15T10:30Z
tenant_id    gpus_in_use    pct_of_pool
noisy-tenant-714   64             85%
orchidbank         4              5%
greenfieldpay      3              4%
others             4              6%
```

sahil: looks like noisy-tenant-714 spiked and is monopolizing reserved allocation within resv-eu-2. autoscaler tried to add replicas but hit max_replicas=12 and then cloud quota errors. logs below.
```
E0315 10:14:02 autoscaler.go:212] scale up failed: create vm instance: quotaExceeded: Insufficient vCPUs in region europe-west2
E0315 10:14:02 autoscaler.go:213] max_replicas reached or cloud quota preventing scale
```

arthur (oncall): ok. immediate triage options: 1) evict noisy tenant from reserved pool and route to shared/hosted fallback, 2) increase max_replicas/config and request cloud quota bump (slow), 3) throttle non-enterprise bursts. what can we do now?
mike: we can force-evict noisy-tenant-714 from resv pool (eviction API) and apply eviction_weight to prefer them for preemption. will cause that tenant's jobs to fail briefly but frees GPUs.
diana: CS: orchidbank and greenfield are paying enterprise customers on reserved contracts — do not evict them. we need to prioritize them.
sahil: agree. plan: 1) apply immediate eviction/preemption to noisy-tenant-714, 2) route orchidbank/greenfieldpay to fallback hosted cluster path with priority routing to preserve requests, 3) open quota request to cloud to increase vCPUs and raise autoscaler max_replicas, 4) keep monitoring and prepare rollback.
arthur (oncall): please run steps and update here. handing incident to sahil for live mitigation. i'm staying on standby. :hand: @sahil you own until stable.
sahil: starting eviction now. running preempt command.
```
# force-evict tenant
platformctl reservations evict --pool resv-eu-2 --tenant noisy-tenant-714 --reason "noisy neighbor - incident 2281234599" --force
```

platform-bot: ACTION: eviction job queued id=evict-2281234599-1 for tenant noisy-tenant-714. Expected free GPUs: 56. ETA 22s.
sahil: eviction completed. verifying free capacity.
```
# post-evict check
poolctl describe resv-eu-2
utilization: 52%
queue_length: 132
```
sahil: queue dropped to 132, several OrchidBank jobs finished, no new 429s reported. but autoscaler still blocked earlier by cloud quota — we should still request a quota bump to avoid recurrence.
diana: CS update: OrchidBank confirms reduced 429s, thanks. GreenfieldPay seeing improvement. sending proactive note.
arthur (oncall): good. can we also add a temporary routing rule so enterprise reserved requests in this pool fallback to hosted before returning 429s? that reduces customer-visible errors.
mike: yes. updating routing policy now. snippet below.
```
# routing change
redwoodctl routing update --pool resv-eu-2 --fallback-route hosted-eu --condition "tenant in [orchidbank, greenfieldpay] and queue>50" --priority 900
```

platform-bot: ROUTING UPDATE applied: fallback to hosted-eu for OrchidBank and GreenfieldPay when queue>50.

sahil: monitoring latency and 429s for those tenants. setting temporary rate-limits for non-enterprise tenants to protect reserved pool.
arthur (oncall): also open a ticket to infra to raise vCPU quota and ask infra-ops to expedite. add paging if no response in 30m.
mike: ticket created: INFRA-4028 - Request vCPU quota increase in europe-west2, linked to this incident. assigned to infra-ops oncall.
diana: CS has sent customer-facing communication for OrchidBank/GreenfieldPay: "we've mitigated immediate impact, routing to hosted fallback to maintain service. investigating root cause and long-term fixes."
arthur (oncall): good. any indication noisy tenant is malicious or misconfigured workload? we should copy platform controls and recommend throttles/limits.
sahil: noisy-tenant-714 owner is internal dev team (sandbox). looks like runaway batch jobs. flagged owner and revoked elevated priority. sending recommended quota/limit config.
mike: long-term actions: 1) enforce per-tenant soft limits in reserved pools, 2) add autoscaler safety margin to avoid hitting cloud quota, 3) improve eviction policy to prefer preemption over customer impact. logged in backlog: PLAT-889.
platform-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigation applied (eviction + routing changes + temporary throttles). Current queue=78, pool utilization=49%. Monitoring for 30m.
arthur (oncall): handing back to sahil for post-incident follow-up and timeline. i'll remain available. make sure to capture all steps for postmortem. cc @customer-success-elaine for customer notes.
customer-success-elaine: noted. I'll coordinate final customer email after postmortem draft.
sahil: will compile timeline and add logs + commands used. estimated time to close: 2 hours pending infra quota response.
arthur (oncall): thanks all. incident is now in MITIGATED state. please continue to observe and update channel if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
